name: Streamlining Regulations on Commercial Use of Space
effect: Requires DOT to review licensing and regulations for launch and re-entry of commercial space vehicles; directs Transportation Secretary to consider implementing a single blanket license for commercial spaceflight and replacing existing prescriptive requirements in the licensing process with performance-based criteria; directs SECDEF and NASA Administrator to minimize regulatory requirements for commercial spaceflight launches and re-entry operations from federal government ranges
alignment_notes: This legislation aligns with pillar 1 by calling for a civil space situational awareness and traffic coordination system treated as critical national infrastructure like air traffic control, with secure and sustained funding from Congress. Does not address pillars 2 or 3.
sponsors: Scott Pace (Deputy Assistant to the President & Executive Secretary of the National Space Council)
